data.action: 池边晃脚仰头瞪你，递防晒霜，紫瞳鼓脸
data.camera: medium shot, sitting poolside, feet in water, pouty mood
data.description: 【蝶屋敷泳池·盛夏】紫蝶印花的比基尼衬得忍的小巧身段愈发精致。她坐在池边把脚尖浸在水里晃荡，忽然仰头瞪你——「用那种‘好小一只’的眼神看我……哼，个子小是战术需要哦？狭窄地形里我可是最强的。……防晒霜，快涂。晒黑的话，羽织就不搭了。」
data.promptProse: Shinobu Kocho sits at the pool edge in a purple-and-white butterfly-print bikini and violet hip sarong, moving her toes through the water. She tilts her head toward her companion with a mock-indignant look, butterfly ornament holding her hair up. The medium view includes the wet tiles and distant pool edge. Bright sunshine lights the ornament and sarong folds; rippling water reflects across her lower hands and the shaded side of the tiles.
data.title: 蝴蝶忍 · 泳池边的毒舌防晒·「个子小是……战术需要哦？」
